title: A Static for the Horizon
author: Juniper Iversen
blurb: Astrid Delacroix, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
